method.pr_cycle: Calendar created_at to merged_at, not work time; nearest-rank p90.
method.ci_wall: Attempt run_started_at to last executed job completed_at; carried jobs excluded. CI percentiles use linear interpolation. No-job wall is null.
method.rework: Visible self-review corrections or external-review rework; not a production defect rate. true/false/null follows reviewed evidence. Stacked propagation alone is not a new rework incident.
method.history: All reachable commit metadata screened; key ADRs, changes and live consumers deep-read, not every historical line audited.
method.benchmarks: Synthetic component costs, not real user latency or a behavior-equivalent regression test.

pr_summary.definition: All PRs updated on/after start; at capture all 97 were created and merged inside the window. Calendar elapsed time, not labor time. First-comment timing is not proven reviewer waiting. Percentiles use nearest rank.
